notes.title: TRex Hero is Now Live! Get Ready for the Adventure!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051971/92550e3b767927c02b6204f577a89741300f9d7e.png[/img]

TRex Hero is officially live! Step into the role of a heroic T-Rex, dodging asteroids to protect future dino generations. Packed with humor, unexpected hazards, and powerful abilities, TRex Hero brings a fun and fresh twist to action gaming.

What to expect:

[list]
[*] Save Dino Eggs: Protect dino eggs from a dangerous asteroid shower, ensuring the survival of your species!
[*] Dodge Hilarious Hazards: Avoid getting your tail burnt, freezing in place, getting electrocuted, and even… throwing up!
[*] Power-Ups to the Rescue: Call in your pterodactyl shield buddy, use a powerful dash, and more to help you survive.
[*] Free Skins Store: Earn coins in-game and unlock skins in our free store—no extra purchases needed!
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has supported us on this journey! We can’t wait for you to join the adventure and become the ultimate TRex Hero. See you in the game tomorrow!
